senses.definition: A public building or room for gambling.
examples: He went to the casino every night till 1:00 am.

quotes.text: A bid by Donald Trump to build Sydney’s first casino was rejected 30 years ago after police expressed concerns about his links to the mafia.

senses.definition: (obsolete) A small house; a pleasure house or holiday home, especially in Italy.
examples: I felt it strange, and regretted it, that so amiable a man should have contracted such dissolute habits, and at this very time, instead of living respectably with his charming Countess, had Baccelli, the superannuated dancing courtesan, in a casino in the neighbourhood.

quotes.text: Quirini [was] knowing in the belles Lettres, & highly skilled in making his Casino comfortable to all the Wits & Blues as we now call them in London.

senses.definition: (uncountable) A certain Italian card game for two to four players.
(countable) Any of certain cards with special meanings in this game.
